info.name: Monoova Payments Financial API
info.description:
# Introduction

Monoova has developed a powerful payments engine which allows you to receive, manage and pay funds in AUD in Australia automatically.

Contact Support:
 Name: Monoova Support
 Email: support@monoova.com

request.description:
The purpose of the execute API is to debit a source for funds then distribute those funds to one or more supplied disbursement accounts. You can use the /financial/v2/transaction/validate endpoint to determine if the parameters are correct.

NPP Payment Pending Status
If you are returned a status of ‘Pending’ for an NPP payout, this means that we are waiting for confirmation that the payment has been processed by the processor.

request.description:
You can use this API to determine if the parameters are correct. The body is the same as /financial/v2/transaction/execute endpoint. The callerUniqueReference will be reusable after the validate call is complete.
Note: You don't need to call this endpoint before an execute as all transactions will be validated before they execute. This is useful if you are using a new rail and want to check your parameters.
